author: Y Combinator
description:
This week's YC Paper Club is focused on data. Three domain experts give talks to break down the challenges and frontiers of training data, benchmarks, and multilingual pre-training.

Apply to Y Combinator: https://www.ycombinator.com/apply
Work at a startup: https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs

Chapters:

00:00 - Francois Chaubard: Why a whole night about data? 
9:51 - Vincent Sunn Chen: The Art & Science of Benchmarking Agents
28:44 - Volo Kuleshov: Inception: Diffusion Language Models for Production
40:26 - Shayne Longpre: ATLAS: Practical Scaling Laws for Multilingual Models
title: Going In Deep On Data | YC Paper Club
